credit: FantasticCurrency ATM, upper half - the screen head and its canopy

elements.name: head
elements.__comment: The screen housing, continuing the body's footprint so the two halves read as one machine.

elements.name: brand_band
elements.__comment: The one tinted surface on the machine. Drawn in greys and multiplied by the issuing bank's colour, which is why it is a separate element sitting a fraction proud of the body: an overlay in the same plane would z-fight, and tinting the whole body would turn a steel cabinet into a block of flat colour.

elements.name: canopy
elements.__comment: Three pixels tall and overhanging the front by one. This is what stops the column reading as two stacked cubes.
